thread:
Maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — https://redwood.in/pm/2026-03-span-loss. We agreed on 4 action items: 1) backfill missing spans, 2) aggregation fix for service-level metrics, 3) ETL alert & runbook, 4) deploy a circuit-breaker for midnight batch overlap. Can owners confirm and give ETA/PRs?

Liam: I can own the backfill and verification. Planning a targeted backfill for affected time ranges and a small verification job to compare pre/post counts.

Tony: I'll take the aggregation fix (aggregation pipeline dedupe + windowing bug). Starting a branch now. ETA: Thur EOD, will post PR when tests green.

Carla: I'll own the ETL alerting and runbook. Will add an auto-escalation to oncall and a playbook for failover. ETA: Tue afternoon.

Maya: Thanks — please add ticket numbers here so I can update the action tracker. Also flag any cross-team blockers.

Liam: Ticket INF-482 created for backfill + verification. Backfill plan gist: https://gist.github.com/liam/backfill-plan. ETA Tue EOD for backfill run; verification job will be Wednesday morning.

Tony: Opened PR #7892 for aggregation fix but hitting a flaky unit test in windowing logic. Failing case: `test_windowed_count_long_tail`. Debugging now. Will post a patch tomorrow.

Carla: Created INF-486 for ETL alerting + runbook. Added initial runbook section and escalation steps. Need someone to grant me access to the staging metrics dashboard (grafana/team-infra). @Tony or @Liam can either give access or point me to a dashboard.

Tony: I can grant access. @Carla, done — you should see `obs-service-pipeline` dashboard.

OpsBot: INF-482 assigned to Liam, INF-486 assigned to Carla, PR #7892 linked to INF-483.

Maya: @Liam once backfill completes can you validate span counts for the top 5 services and post a short table in the ticket? We need to be sure we didn't over/under-report.

Liam: Yep — will run a quick diff script after the backfill. Script: `python tools/span_diff.py --services svcA,svcB,svcC --before 2026-03-14T00:00Z --after 2026-03-15T00:00Z`

Tony: @Liam can you also sanity-check the aggregation output I have in the staging dataset? I can run a compare job after your verification.

Liam: Sure. Once backfill is done I'll kick off compare and share results in INF-482.

Carla: Observed recurring pattern note: spike in missing spans at midnight UTC that lines up with large batch window from billing job. I've added a line to the runbook to check `batch_completion_time` histogram and job overlap.

Tony: I'll work on adding a circuit-breaker to the scheduler to prevent overlap. Will add tests and a feature flag. Ticket INF-487. ETA Fri.

Maya: Good — can we capture owners + dates in the PM action tracker by EOD? I'll send a quick reminder to stakeholders after this thread.

Liam: Added owners + ETAs to INF-482. Backfill schedule is in the ticket comment.

Carla: INF-486 runbook updated with dashboard links and escalation matrix. Also scheduled a short runbook review with oncall Mon 10:30am.

Tony: PR #7892 updated with a fix for the flaky test, added a regression unit. CI is green on the branch now. Linking test results: https://ci.redwood/7892.

OpsBot: Reminder set: ping owners 48h before each ETA (owners: Liam, Tony, Carla).

Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll close the loop in the postmortem doc and move these into the quarterly remediations board. If anything slips, mark the ticket and tag `#incidents`.

Liam: ack :thumbsup:

Tony: ack :thumbsup:

Carla: ack :thumbsup:

OpsBot: Bot note: next incident follow-up check-in scheduled at 1874600000.
